n = int(input())
b = int(input())
diffs = []
arr = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if i > 0 and evenCount == oddCount:
        diffs.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]))
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1

diffs.sort()
result = 0
for d in diffs:
    if d <= b:
        b -= d
        result += 1
    else:
        break

print(result)
